title: uHub 3D asset manifest
description: One asset draft, or an array of drafts for a batch. Relative paths resolve from the manifest file's folder (from the current directory when the manifest comes from stdin).

name.description: Display name; sanitized to [A-Za-z0-9_], spaces become _.

category.description: Category folder; same sanitizing as name.

modelSrc.description: Model file (.fbx or .obj). Required for assetType model.

hdriSrc.description: HDRI file (.hdr). Required for assetType hdri.

thumbnailSrc.description: Optional thumbnail override image (.png/.jpg/.jpeg/.tga). Replaces the rendered thumbnail (fit 512). Prefer leaving this out so the view is rendered.

rotation.description: HDRI rotation in degrees (0 when unused).

originalName.description: Name of the material inside the model file (FBX/OBJ). Mesh groups bind to drafts by this name. For material assets, repeat the asset name.

name.description: Final material name in the library (deduped with _2, _3 on collision).

value.description: Scalar (number) for Metallic/Roughness/Specular/Opacity, or [r, g, b] linear colour for BaseColor/Emissive. Omit when a texture is given.

textureSrc.description: Texture image (.png/.jpg/.jpeg/.tga). BaseColor and Emissive textures are read as sRGB; all others as linear data.

normalY.description: Green-channel convention of a Normal texture.
